name: openarc
description: Turns a code change into an interactive architecture diagram for review.

interface.longDescription: OpenArc turns a code change into an interactive architecture diagram: the components it adds, changes or removes, how control flows through them, Klar pseudocode for each function, and the risks a reviewer should weigh. It writes a single self-contained HTML page.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make an OpenArc for the changes on this branch
